baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal equation joins al-hayat al-dunya to la'ib and lahw before the conditional promise.
baseline_models.mechanism: Life is not denied value in itself; its nearest horizon compresses attention until action loses a sound end and one occupation displaces another. The predicate diagnoses a mode of attending to life, not life's nonexistence.

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit keeps the diagnosis centered on how life is used rather than treating life as sheer nothingness.
Nearness supplies the shortened horizon in which immediate objects dominate attention.
Action pursued without a sound end supplies motion detached from durable purpose.
Occupation by one thing away from another makes distraction the causal link between nearness and purposeless action.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply declares the world trivial.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses a near-horizon attention regime in which beneficial life is converted into aimless motion and displacement from a truer end.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional chain tu'minu, tattaqu, yu'tikum ujurakum is closed by wa-la yas'alkum amwalakum.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust and self-protection establish a guarded relationship whose return is given recompense. The closing negation distinguishes that relationship from a revenue system that treats the addressees' accumulated property as its required input.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust make faith the relational basis of the conditional rather than a bare label.
Putting oneself within protection supplies the active guarded posture paired with trust.
Giving fixes the direction of transfer from the divine giver toward the guarded believers.
Return for work supplies the covenant's recompense vocabulary without making wealth its fuel.
Requesting or seeking supplies the expressly negated direction of demand.
Accumulated property identifies what is not made the divine counter-payment.

changed_reading.before: Belief and piety earn payment while property happens to remain untouched.
changed_reading.after: Trust and protective conduct enter a giver-to-recipient covenant whose recompense is structurally contrasted with requisitioning the recipients' capital.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Material branches of hayat, la'ib, lahw, yu'ti, and ajr form a focus-only chain around the contrast with amwal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rain-quickened growth enters a near, perishable throughput system: wind can erase its sites and grain is fed into a mill. The promise reverses depletion by bringing yield and mending fracture without claiming the stored stock of wealth.

activation_trace.role: Rain-revived earth supplies the living input of a regenerative material cycle.
Wind erasing a dwelling supplies the cycle's exposure to dispersal and loss.
Grain cast into a mill supplies a throughput image in which worldly material is consumed by process.
Emergent yield or produce turns the promised giving into regenerative output.
Mending a break supplies restoration rather than simple monetary equivalence as the return.
Stored property supplies the stock that this regenerative giver does not consume as an input.

changed_reading.before: Play and diversion are only psychological faults, and reward is only a wage.
changed_reading.after: The focus can also image a perishable throughput economy answered by yield and repair rather than depletion of accumulated stock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence repeatedly gives earthly action a real outcome, sets truth against nullity, tests people so their condition appears, and forbids nullifying works. This confines play and diversion to a corrupted mode of action rather than making embodied life or action inconsequential.

activation_trace.role: Aimless action remains the focus diagnosis that context now limits to action lacking a sound end.
Displacement from a proper object explains how consequential action can nevertheless become diversion.
Intended work supplies a consequential unit that can be lost, repaired, or preserved across the surah.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the durable end against which play's aimlessness is measured.
Testing that reveals condition makes the worldly arena evidentiary rather than empty.
The command not to remove or nullify work proves that earthly action can retain real value.

structural_cues: The surah opens with works being lost or repaired and later explicitly forbids their nullification before the focus labels the near life play and diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies consequential work, truth, revealing tests, and avoidable nullification; I infer that these restrict the focus predicate to misoriented life. A live alternative is that the predicate still devalues the whole temporal arena while exempting only divinely directed acts.

changed_reading.before: Calling worldly life play and diversion makes all action in it negligible.
changed_reading.after: Worldly life is a consequential testing arena, while play and diversion name the way real action is emptied of its proper end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier martial scene alternates release without exchange, ransom, war's material burden, and testing; immediately before the focus, work is promised not to be deprived. Against that field, reward and wealth in 47:36 demote capture, ransom, and spoils as the ultimate economy.

activation_trace.role: Recompense for work supplies an alternative measure of gain to material seizure.
Accumulated property supplies the material stake explicitly denied as divine revenue.
Release without compensation introduces a non-exchange disposition within the martial scene.
Ransoming a captive supplies the explicit exchange alternative whose material logic is later relativized.
War's branch of stripping property exposes the extractive economy latent in conflict.
War burdens supply the temporary load that is eventually laid down.
Testing that reveals condition assigns conflict an evidentiary function rather than an ultimate economic end.
Not depriving a right or work directly prepares the focus promise of recompense.

structural_cues: The focus follows a prohibition on weakness and premature peace together with assurance that works will not be diminished.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, ransom, property-stripping war, burdens, test, and non-deprivation; I infer a contrast between martial extraction and divine recompense. The live alternative is that these scenes only supply moral urgency and do not define an economic contrast.

changed_reading.before: The wealth clause is a general aside after an abstract statement about worldly triviality.
changed_reading.after: Within a martial surah, the clause also refuses to make capture, ransom, spoils, or deprivation the final economy by which divine reward is measured.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unusual focus branch of ajr as mending a crooked break is activated by repeated repair of inner condition and stabilization of feet. Recompense can therefore be carried as restored capacity and trajectory alongside the ordinary wage reading.

activation_trace.role: Mending a fracture on its remaining crookedness supplies a reparative sense of recompense.
Repair opposed to corruption gives the ajr-as-mending branch a repeated contextual action.
A repaired and eased condition identifies the human state being restored.
Making something fit for its function supplies repair as restored usability.
Ease of condition repeats the non-monetary result of divine action.
Strengthening and fixing in place supplies the mechanical completion of repair.
The feet identify repaired agency as the ability to stand and continue on a path.

structural_cues: Repair of bal appears twice before the focus, and stabilization of feet follows the same conditional reciprocity used in 47:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ajr's fracture branch plus repair, eased condition, and stabilized feet; I infer that these name one restorative return. The ordinary payment sense of ajr remains fully live and may be primary.

changed_reading.before: Ujurakum denotes an externally added payment.
changed_reading.after: Ujurakum can simultaneously include repaired condition, restored fitness, and steady footing as the return of trustful action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dunya's nearness becomes temporal mispricing: attention values the immediately present while neglecting the last consequence, although preliminary signs have appeared and the decisive event can arrive suddenly, after which reminder no longer functions.

activation_trace.role: The nearer or first horizon supplies the temporal bias under diagnosis.
Displacement of attention explains why the near horizon eclipses later consequence.
The last outcome supplies the distant term omitted by near-horizon valuation.
Sudden arrival supplies the temporal discontinuity that makes distraction costly.
Preliminary signs show that suddenness does not mean absence of prior evidence.
A reminder that recalls what was neglected supplies the attentional remedy whose opportunity can expire.

structural_cues: 47:10 directs travel toward prior outcomes, while 47:18 juxtaposes waiting, signs already present, sudden arrival, and belated remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, last outcomes, signs, suddenness, and reminder; I infer a temporal valuation error linking them. A live alternative is that dunya here stresses low rank rather than temporal proximity.

changed_reading.before: Dunya means a morally low world whose pleasures are intrinsically frivolous.
changed_reading.after: Dunya also names the nearer horizon whose immediacy is overvalued until signs, consequence, and sudden arrival expose the pricing error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opposes enjoyment reduced to repeated intake with ongoing flow, clarified substance, fruit, and settlement. Play and diversion therefore need not condemn enjoyment as such; they mark a consumptive loop severed from cultivation, continuity, and produced benefit.

activation_trace.role: Rain-revived growth anchors the focus in a cultivable living process.
Action without a sound end names consumption detached from durable production.
Enjoyable benefit supplies the category that can be used either as terminal consumption or as genuine provision.
Repeated taking-in of food supplies the closed consumptive loop in the negative comparison.
Continuous provision supplies an open flow that contrasts with terminal intake.
Settlement and abiding supply the long-term state produced by one's mode of consumption.
Channels cut by flowing water supply organized continuity rather than dissipative throughput.
Clarification from admixture supplies qualitative transformation within enjoyment.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the productive result missing from aimless play.

structural_cues: 47:12 places repeated eating beside a final abode, while 47:15 expands the counter-image into four rivers, clarified substances, and every fruit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enjoyment, intake, continuous provision, channels, clarification, fruit, and settlement; I infer two opposed resource cycles. The live alternative is a simpler moral contrast between two groups' destinations without an implied cultivation model.

changed_reading.before: The focus rejects worldly enjoyment because pleasure itself is play.
changed_reading.after: The focus rejects terminal consumption without durable end, while context preserves a cultivated, flowing, purified, and fruitful form of enjoyment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same contextual sequence says that those guided are increased in guidance and are given their taqwa. Because 47:36 names taqwa as a condition and giving as the response, condition and gift form a recursive loop rather than a one-way wage transaction.

activation_trace.role: Self-placement within protection supplies the apparent human-side condition in the focus.
Giving supplies the focus's result and makes its contextual repetition structurally salient.
Gentle direction followed by further direction supplies the recursive growth pattern.
Increase and growth turn prior guidance into the ground of additional guidance.
The contextual act of giving points toward the very protective quality named next.
Taqwa as the given object folds the focus condition back into divine provision.

structural_cues: 47:17 and 47:36 repeat the sequence of guidance or faith, taqwa, and divine giving with taqwa changing grammatical side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated guidance, increase, giving, and taqwa as object; I infer a recursive gift-condition relation. A live alternative is that 47:17 gives only the capacity or due measure of taqwa, leaving 47:36's condition straightforwardly human action.

changed_reading.before: Believers independently supply faith and taqwa, then receive wages in exchange.
changed_reading.after: The response is recursive: received guidance and given taqwa enable the guarded conduct to which further recompense answers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Listening can become understanding and compliance or remain sealed; locks block deliberation, while marks, angled speech, and testing expose inward condition. The focus's faith and taqwa are therefore operative orientations revealed through reception, speech, and tested action, not merely asserted identities.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inward orientation whose reality context tests.
Active self-guarding supplies the outwardly consequential posture paired with assent.
Hearing as understanding and compliance distinguishes reception from mere acoustic exposure.
A stamped seal supplies the mechanism by which inward reception is closed.
Closure and hardness supply a second mechanism blocking deliberative access to the heart.
A visible mark from which condition is inferred supplies outward legibility of an inward state.
The slant of speech toward its implication supplies a second channel through which concealed orientation leaks out.
Testing that makes condition appear supplies the causal disclosure procedure.
Knowledge of a report and an affair's interior makes tested outputs evidence of hidden state.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from listeners who ask what was said, through diseased and locked hearts, to recognition by mark and speech and finally the testing of reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies receptive hearing, seals, locks, diagnostic marks, speech slant, tests, and inward knowledge; I infer that these operationalize the focus's faith and guarding. A live alternative is that they classify separate groups without redefining the condition in 47:36.

changed_reading.before: If you believe and guard refers to declared affiliation plus general piety.
changed_reading.after: Faith and guarding are inwardly rooted but behaviorally legible capacities whose reality emerges in reception, tonal leakage, and pressure-tested action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the closing movement, works can collapse, be actively nullified, or be deprived of their due; the reassurance denies the last possibility. Ujurakum thus includes preservation of the valid work-result relation, not merely an added prize.

activation_trace.role: Return attached to work supplies the ledger relation whose integrity the context tests.
Collapse and descent supply the failure mode in which works lose effective result.
Intended works identify what undergoes collapse rather than neutral bookkeeping loss.
Active removal or nullification supplies an avoidable human-side failure mode.
The repeated object ties nullification to the same intended-work account.
A loss that strips a right or work supplies the deprivation expressly denied just before the focus.
The wage of work bridges the non-deprivation assurance directly into ujurakum.

structural_cues: 47:32-36 forms a tight sequence of collapsed works, a prohibition on nullifying works, no deprivation of works, and then the giving of recompenses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three modes of work-result failure followed by recompense; I infer a protected ledger in which valid work is allowed to bear its due. A live alternative is that each statement concerns a distinct consequence without a single ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Reward is a bonus added after action.
changed_reading.after: Reward also names the safeguarded fruition of action: work is not allowed to collapse, be self-nullified, or be stripped of its due.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent verses do call the addressees to let wealth go out, but distinguish invitation from an exhaustive, pressuring demand that would provoke withholding and exposure. Divine self-sufficiency and human need remove divine revenue-need as the reason for spending.

activation_trace.role: The negated request supplies the claim that the adjacent verses qualify rather than erase.
Accumulated property supplies the object whose demanded extent becomes decisive.
The hypothetical request resumes the focus verb and makes the counterfactual scope test explicit.
Exhaustive insistence supplies the pressure and totalizing extent denied by the focus.
Withholding supplies the predictable human response to exhaustive pressure.
Bringing something out from concealment supplies the disclosure effect of that pressure.
Calling by speech supplies invitation rather than confiscatory seizure as the mode of mobilization.
Money going out in expenditure proves that the focus is not an absolute ban on every wealth request.
Self-sufficiency removes divine need as the causal explanation for the call to spend.
Human need relocates the benefit and cost of spending to the addressees themselves.

structural_cues: The pronoun object in 47:37 resumes the wealth of 47:36, and 47:38 immediately issues an actual call to spend while contrasting divine sufficiency with human need.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negated request, a counterfactual exhaustive request, withholding, an actual invitation to spend, divine sufficiency, and human need; I infer that scope and mode distinguish them. A live alternative is that the focus idiom means only that God does not ask for all wealth, with no broader governance contrast.

changed_reading.before: God never asks believers to part with wealth.
changed_reading.after: God calls wealth into voluntary expenditure but does not requisition it exhaustively or from need; the benefit and danger remain on the human side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hypothetical exhaustive demand would force concealed hostility outward, while withholding in fact turns against the withholder's own self. The focus's restraint can therefore be read as governance that preserves voluntary trust while still exposing the self-harming structure of refusal.

activation_trace.role: Trust and security supply the relational good that coercive extraction would damage.
A barrier against harm supplies the protective function of limiting the demand.
Pressing a matter to exhaustion supplies the coercive stressor that threatens trust.
Extraction from concealment supplies the stressor's diagnostic result.
The living self identifies the ultimate bearer of the loss caused by withholding.

structural_cues: The branchless root ض غ ن at 47:37 word 6 structurally names what exhaustive pressure would expose; no branch identity is assigned to it.
47:38 redirects the effect of withholding back onto the withholder's own self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive pressure, emergence from concealment, hidden rancor structurally, and self-directed loss; I infer that restrained demand protects a trust relation while preserving diagnosis. A live alternative is that the passage merely predicts reaction and does not present restraint as a governance mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Not asking for wealth only expresses divine detachment from material goods.
changed_reading.after: The limited demand also functions as trust-preserving restraint: exhaustive extraction would externalize concealed hostility, whereas voluntary refusal already harms the refusing self.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface construction plainly supports ordinary asking, while the packet also maps the QAC root to a distinct branch family of gently or secretly drawing something out. It remains anchored in yas'alkum and is activated by the adjacent exhaustive asking and emergence from concealment; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary extraction echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated yas'alkum is immediately repeated in 47:37 with an object pronoun referring back to the wealth.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden drawing-out supplies an extraction undertone beneath the overtly negated request.
Secret taking sharpens the undertone from neutral request to covert depletion.
The repeated form carries the drawing-out echo into the counterfactual demand.
Exhaustive insistence supplies the force that would turn asking into extraction.
Bringing hidden material out supplies the adjacent result that makes the extraction echo functional.

changed_reading.before: He does not verbally request your wealth.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory secondary level, He does not draw your wealth out by concealed or exhaustive extraction, which would also pull concealed inner material into view.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates bodily mouth branches of la'ib and lahw rather than their normal abstract senses. It remains focus-anchored and gains coherence from contextual eating, drinking, and diagnostic tone; downstream prose should call it an embodied associative image, not lexicalize the verse as saliva or throat anatomy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacent focus nouns la'ib and lahw each carry packet branches located at the mouth and throat.

activation_trace.role: Saliva flowing from the mouth supplies an uncontrolled intake-output threshold.
Animal secretion extending to honey or venom makes the same oral flow capable of nourishment or harm.
The flesh above the throat supplies the bodily gate through which intake and voiced output pass.
Repeated eating activates the intake side of the mouth-gate mechanism.
Drinking activates a second controlled passage through the same bodily threshold.
Shaped tone supplies the diagnostic output side of the oral system.

changed_reading.before: Play and diversion are disembodied categories of frivolous behavior.
changed_reading.after: As an associative bodily model, worldly distraction becomes a mouth-gate economy of appetite and voiced leakage, where what enters and exits can nourish, poison, or disclose orientation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the spider branch under mal is remote from ordinary amwal, and the tunnel branches under spending are likewise image-level activations. The model remains anchored in the focus wealth noun and the immediate spending context, but downstream prose should qualify it as a network analogy rather than claim that wealth literally means a web.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Amwal closes the focus and is resumed by the spending and withholding sequence of 47:37-38.

activation_trace.role: The spider supplies a web-like network image for property relations and attachments.
A tunnel with a through-exit supplies circulation through the property network.
A visible entrance with a concealed exit supplies opacity in where resources go and how attachment is maintained.
A precious object over which selves compete supplies the attachment pressure binding the web.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is a static quantity that may or may not be surrendered.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wealth is a web of valued attachments whose health depends on open exits and circulation; withholding tightens the network around the self.

strongest_changes: The context prevents play and diversion from making earthly action inconsequential: works are tested, repaired, nullified, preserved, and recompensed.
Because 47:17 says taqwa is given, the focus condition and reward form a recursive gift loop rather than a simple wage exchange.
47:37-38 revises no wealth request into no exhaustive or need-driven extraction while preserving an actual invitation to spend.
Reward remains multiply readable as wage, repaired condition, preserved work-result, and regenerative yield.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits between assurance that works will not be deprived and a counterfactual exhaustive wealth-demand followed by a real call to spend. That placement keeps non-extraction, consequential action, inward testing, and voluntary circulation live together; split and material branches additionally activate carefully contained extraction, oral, and ecological models.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the wealth negation excludes any request, all wealth specifically, or coercive and exhaustive demand as a mode.
How strongly ajr's fracture-repair branch should shape prose beside its ordinary wage sense.
Whether dunya's temporal nearness or its lower rank carries more weight in the attention model.
Whether given taqwa is the same operative condition named in 47:36 or a further capacity granted after prior guidance.
How much interpretive weight the material and split-root outliers can bear beyond secondary imagery.
